articles.summary: If you think insurance can’t move at AI speed, meet Lemonade. The future of insurance marketing is AI first personalization, not louder discounts. This is how Lemonade used AI-decisioning to learn fast, cut regret from underperforming variants, and prove that friendly + speed beats “cheap + easy” for conversion.
articles.title: Insurance at AI speed: Lemonade’s growth with AI decisioning

articles.title: Meet JustAI
